06 / KEY LEARNINGS

CREATIVITY NEEDS
EXECUTION.

Accessible Creative Mechanics

A simple seasonal keyword challenge can make financial-market content approachable and shareable.

Tracking & Validation

Strong engagement still requires clear form tracking and eligibility screening to translate attention into valid entries.

End-to-End Completion

A campaign is not complete at announcement: winner confirmation and prize delivery matter to the participant experience.
